_comment: Base Sepolia REHEARSAL deployment (2026-11-24, the third one, a full redeploy with the owner's go-ahead). Not production. It adds caretakers (Staking.setCaretaker: a staker's other wallets may feed, roll, and ascend its staked Words) and Staking's guard against Words sent to it directly (#171), on top of the pre-mainnet audit fixes and the 4,584-word dictionary. $WORD here is contracts/test/mocks/MockERC20.sol (permissionless mint(), the in-game testnet faucet), reused from the first rehearsal. No swap router ($WORD-only, as at launch). The AnswerChain head is the throwaway rehearsal schedule. The bounty carve is 1500 bps from deploy.
